{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the presence of commas in revenue
print("Rows where revenue contains commas:")
print(sales[sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)].head())

# Now parse revenue by removing commas and converting to float
cleaned_revenue = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for the QA orders with 999999.99
print("\nCount of QA orders (revenue == 999999.99):", (cleaned_revenue == 999999.99).sum())

# Check for refunded orders
print("\nStatus distribution:")
print(sales['status'].value_counts())"}
